problem: Large documentation sets become ambiguous when agents cannot reliably distinguish current SSOT from experiments, proof history and superseded plans.
invariant: Every repository should expose a documentation entry point that routes work to explicit authoritative sources and prevents top-level documentation from becoming invisible.
evidence: AGENTS.md documentation SSOT and freshness rules
failure_behavior: Fail when the docs index is missing required authority links, contains broken local links, or omits top-level documentation that the repository contract requires to be indexed.
